preamble: Occlusion of the voiceless lateral fricative [ɬ] to the plosive [t]: the tongue tip keeps its alveolar closure while the lateral airflow is shut off. In Khanty, Proto-Khanty *ɬ (from Proto-Uralic *s and *š) splits the dialects three ways: it stays ɬ in Kazym and Surgut, becomes l in Obdorsk (Shuryshkar) and the Far Eastern dialects (Vakh, Vasyugan), and becomes t in the Middle Ob and Southern (Irtysh, Konda) dialects. Proto-Khanty *l (from Proto-Uralic *l and *δ) merged with *ɬ in most dialects and gives the same t in the t-dialects, e.g. *kɔlǝm 'three' > Middle Ob хутум.

languageExamples.language: Proto-Khanty to Middle Ob and Southern (Konda) Khanty
